Your mortgage application is in jeopardy. We've been waiting {{$json.followUpDetails.daysSinceRequest}} days for these critical documents:

{{#each $json.missingDocuments}}

- Technical issues? We'll walk you through upload
- Questions about requirements? We'll explain everything

💬 Live Chat: [Document Help Chat - {{$json.id}}]
